PrivacyPage.title: Privacy
PrivacyPage.intro: This page explains, in plain language, what happens to your data when you use this site.
PrivacyPage.collectionBody: If you use the contact form, it sends your name, email address, and message to me by email. That's the only data this site actively collects.
PrivacyPage.usageBody: Cloudflare Turnstile checks that the form submission isn't automated spam, and Resend delivers the email to my inbox at hello@yushko.dev. Neither service is used for anything beyond that. The message isn't stored in a database — it just lands in my inbox like any other email, and I reply the same way.
PrivacyPage.analyticsBody: This site may use Cloudflare Web Analytics, a cookieless, privacy-friendly analytics service — it reports aggregate page views without tracking individual visitors or setting any tracking cookies.
PrivacyPage.retentionBody: There's no separate database, so there's nothing to delete beyond the email itself, which I manage like any other message in my inbox.
PrivacyPage.contactBody: For anything about your data, email hello@yushko.dev.
